channel.title: Artometrics Reports
channel.description: Data reports on culture, power, and the creative economy — Arts, Sports, Science, Humanities, Civics, Culture.

item.title: $3.9bn for Zero Championships: Inside the Padres' Record Sale
item.description: San Diego sold for $3.9bn in May 2026 — a record — despite 57 seasons and zero titles. The price measures demand, not delivery.

item.title: $3.9 Billion Buys the Padres—But Not a Championship Blueprint
item.description: José E. Feliciano and Kwanza Jones paid a record $3.9bn for a club drawing 42,000 a game, ranked last in farm talent, and carrying $858m owed to five underperforming stars.

item.title: Beyoncé and the Cost of Controlling the House
item.description: A Psychonomics profile of Beyoncé — Hermann Leadership Trait Analysis, Parkwood as institutionalized self, Lemonade’s canon economics, and an 8,000-line lyric machine.

item.title: A ¥10.3 million trademark award in China turned a legal win into a cultural reckoning
item.description: Louis Vuitton won ¥10.3 million against Molly Tea in Suzhou court on 29 June 2026 for four-petal logo infringement. Chinese social media reframed the first-to-file trademark case as foreign enclosure of Tang-era motifs.

item.title: Netflix Holds 4,800 Titles While Marketing 40: What Catalog Data Shows About Platform Inventory
item.description: Public streaming inventories reveal 90% of titles generate less than 1% of engagement while platforms market the same 50 properties quarterly.

item.title: Oscars vs Grammys: How Award Shows Build Prestige
item.description: How Oscars, Grammys, and Nobels manufacture legitimacy differently. Oscar prestige ties to market; Nobel prestige ties to institutional memory.

item.title: California leads in GDP and tech, Texas in energy and migration—7 dimensions of the most-compared state rivalry
item.description: California scores 96 on GDP, 94 on tech; Texas scores 96 on energy, 91 on migration attention. Seven dimensions explain why the comparison persists.

item.title: 18 NBA titles have turned the Celtics into a franchise judged against its own history
item.description: 18 NBA championships—11 in the Russell era alone—mean every Boston season is compared to Bill Russell and Larry Bird, not to Miami or Milwaukee.

item.title: What does a city export? A data framework for economic identity
item.description: 1,667 subnational regions and 1,100+ datasets define the economic signature of cities — exports, housing, transit, culture, and historical infrastructure.

item.title: Dallas Cowboys carry $10B franchise value through 29-year championship drought
item.description: Dallas holds $10B+ in franchise value but hasn't won an NFC championship in 29 years—a widening gap between attention and playoff output.

item.title: Film and music lead cultural export scales; South Korea's soft-power index rose 70 points since 1990
item.description: Film scores 91 on exportability, music 88. South Korea's cultural wave index climbed from 22 in 1990 to 92 in 2025 across eight mediums and 45 cities.

item.title: The Dodgers won 111 games in 2022—and still needed two titles to prove the machine works
item.description: Twelve straight playoff trips, eight championships, and 32 years between rings reveal how payroll and depth buy access—but not closure.

item.title: U.S. Platforms, Chinese Factories, German Machines: Three Export Systems
item.description: The U.S., China, and Germany dominate trade through different architectures — platform control, manufacturing scale, and industrial precision.

item.title: How Movies Become Famous on IMDb’s Public Scoreboard
item.description: Title fields, ratings, and box-office references explain how films accumulate attention.

item.title: 17 championships — how the Lakers convert star gravity into title eras
item.description: 17 championships, 32 Finals appearances — Los Angeles converts market gravity into recurring title windows through six distinct star eras.

item.title: NFL Franchises Average $6.5B — Why League Rules, Not Market Size, Set Team Value
item.description: NFL teams average $6.5B because 17-game scarcity compresses variance; MLB's 162 games let payroll spread; NBA star leverage hits 92.

item.title: Catalog Depth and Genre Travel Predict Pop Fame Duration
item.description: Artists with 15+ release groups and 3+ genre tags sustain fame 40% longer than single-era acts, per MusicBrainz metadata analysis.

item.title: Germany Sells Machines, Saudi Arabia Sells Oil—What Does Your Country Sell?
item.description: Export ledgers reveal national identity under market constraint—200+ countries, 5,000+ products, six diagnostic questions.

item.title: New York commands capital while San Francisco invents the future
item.description: New York legitimizes and commands global systems; San Francisco prototypes them. Both export intangible power, not goods.

item.title: Power, Art, and Science Dominate Global Memory—85,000 Lives in MIT's Pantheon Dataset
item.description: 85,000+ biographies in MIT's Pantheon dataset reveal which occupations and cities compound fame across languages—and which achievements remain local.

item.title: Six Super Bowls in 19 Seasons — The Patriots' Systemic Discontinuity
item.description: Six championships in 19 seasons compressed a century of legacy into one Brady–Belichick era that rewrote franchise identity.

item.title: English Commands 72% of Gutenberg's 75,000-Book Public-Domain Shelf
item.description: English titles hold 72% of indexed Gutenberg availability; 19th-century fiction peaks at 2.8× other eras; adventure and gothic subjects adapt 3× faster.

item.title: Large U.S. markets anchor six distinct sports identity patterns
item.description: Ten major markets split into six identity archetypes shaped by title density, league mix, and championship drought.

item.title: Can San Francisco Absorb Its Own Invention Machine?
item.description: A small city exports global software wealth while underbuilding the physical infrastructure to metabolize it.

item.title: Which Sports Dynasties Convert Finals Appearances Into Championships?
item.description: The Yankees hold 27 titles but convert 40% of Finals trips; the Patriots won 6 of 11 Super Bowls at 55% conversion across MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL since 1950.

item.title: 27 Championships Built the Yankees' Empire—15 Years Without One Defines the Modern Paradox
item.description: 27 titles create expectations no payroll can meet: the Yankees spend like champions but haven't converted October access into rings since 2009.

item.title: Airline Safety by Capacity: How Incident Counts Hide Exposure Differences
item.description: 336 airline records show capacity dominates safety rankings—United leads at 7.1B seat-km/week, but incident counts don't scale linearly with size.

item.title: Who Drinks the Most Alcohol Per Capita?
item.description: Country-level consumption data map which nations drink the most per person—and how that has shifted.

item.title: Pizza Price Floors: How a 10,000-Row Menu Extract Reveals Two Economies
item.description: 10,000 pizza menu records show a median price floor of 0.00 and a premium tier reaching 50.0, encoding two separate markets in one dataset.

item.title: Beyoncé and Taylor Swift, Line by Line
item.description: A lyric-level comparison of two era-defining catalogs—theme, language, and structure.

item.title: What Twenty Years of Big Mac Prices Say About Purchasing Power
item.description: Global burger prices illustrate how currency and wages shape the real cost of everyday goods.

item.title: How Far Do Portland’s Biketown Rides Actually Go?
item.description: Trip-level bike-share data measures typical distance and duration across Biketown journeys.

item.title: How Long Number-One Hits Stay on Top of the Hot 100
item.description: Since 1958, most chart-toppers lasted weeks; a few held for months—and streaming rewrote the pattern.

item.title: How the Top of the Billboard Chart Got More Crowded
item.description: Large-scale Hot 100 data show how rankings compress at the summit.

item.title: Which Board Games Combine Crowd Scale With Elite Ratings?
item.description: Ratings and popularity across thousands of titles find games that win both mass attention and esteem.

item.title: Springsteen On Broadway Commands $509 Average Ticket—Double Hamilton's $273
item.description: Springsteen On Broadway averages $509 per ticket—nearly double Hamilton's $273. Concert residencies occupy the summit; traditional musicals cluster near the $60 industry median.

item.title: CEO Tenure Caps at 2.5 Years in 9,423 Departure Records
item.description: Median tenure coded at 1.0 year; "Interim" label accounts for 218 observations in TidyTuesday departures extract.

item.title: Captive cetacean transfers peaked in 1972 with 170 US-logged records
item.description: 2,172 of 2,194 cetacean transfer records are US-labeled; bottlenose dolphins account for 1,668 entries in a 1946–2017 captivity ledger.

item.title: Victorian Authors Dominate the Christmas Novel Canon
item.description: A Gutenberg holiday corpus shows a median author birthdate of 1859 and Dickens as the most common name.

item.title: Jingle Bell Rock spent 19 weeks on chart across six decades
item.description: 387 holiday songs tracked 1958–2017 show a median 8-week chart life, with standards like Jingle Bell Rock returning across decades.

item.title: China holds 1.36 billion people against a 5.2 million median — five countries control 72% of aggregate population
item.description: China's 1.36 billion against a 5.2 million median — the top five countries hold 72% of aggregate population in the CIA World Factbook extract.

item.title: Psychology Graduates Fill 48,207 Low-Wage Jobs—Four Times Business Majors
item.description: Psychology leads 173 majors with 48,207 low-wage jobs; engineering's median is 372—a hundredfold gap in labor-market absorption.

item.description: Spider-Man logged 4,043 appearances across 1935–2013; the top five characters account for 45% of cumulative appearances among 23,272 records.

item.title: U.S. Craft Beer Peaks at 12.8% ABV; Median Remains 6%
item.description: Analysis of 2,410 U.S. craft beers shows median ABV of 6%, maximum 12.8%, and high bitterness concentrated in the IPA cluster.

item.title: Saturday Night Live Earned 859 Emmy Records—More Than Any Other Show
item.description: Saturday Night Live appears 859 times across 29,678 Emmy records from 1957–2021—three times the next-closest show.

item.title: Colorado leads U.S. exercise participation at 32.0; median state posts 23.0
item.description: Colorado leads at 32.0; median across 52 U.S. jurisdictions is 23.0, with Western and New England states dominating the top tier.

item.title: 515 Fast-Food Items: Median 490 Calories, Ceiling 2,430
item.description: 515 U.S. fast-food menu items show a median of 490 calories — top 12 items median 1,315; Sonic sits 80 above median, Chick-fil-A 100 below.

item.title: Global median life expectancy nearly tripled in five centuries
item.description: Global median life expectancy rose from 33.9 to 73 years between 1543 and 2015, yet top countries still outlive the lowest by more than two-to-one.

item.title: Median GDP per capita doubled 1700–2017 while plastic mismanagement stayed geographically uneven
item.description: 22,204 country-year records show high income funds collection but does not guarantee low leakage; coastal economies face mismanagement risk at any income level.

item.title: Horror's median rating rose 0.35 points as catalog volume grew 50× in seven decades
item.description: 32,540 horror films from 1950–2022 show median vote average climbed from 5.65 to 6.00 — modest quality gain amid explosive catalog growth.

item.title: Hurricane Maria delivered 5,072-unit peak to Puerto Rico in 2017 three-state season
item.description: Texas, Florida, and Puerto Rico absorbed 100% of measured 2017 hurricane impact in 153-record TidyTuesday extract; median reading 703, ceiling 5,072.

item.title: Singapore's wastewater plants discharge 200× the global median
item.description: Facility-level data show median discharge at 1,079 m³/day; Singapore's plants average 223,683.

item.title: U.S. Incarceration by County, 1970–2016 — Median Population 3,553, Top Exceeds 6.8 Million
item.description: County-level population data show regional regimes that diverge for decades, not one national curve.

item.title: 8,612 Glottolog records concentrate 27% in Africa — a map of fieldwork, not speech
item.description: 2,363 of 8,612 language records sit in Africa's macroarea bucket — a signal of documentation density, not speaker counts.

item.title: LEGO's median set shrank to 60 pieces while flagship builds hit 11,695
item.description: Median part counts dropped from 142 to 59.5 as World Map and display sets pushed the complexity ceiling past 11,000 pieces.

item.title: Medium posts at 4 minutes median — does length predict claps?
item.description: 78,388 Medium articles from 2017–2018 show median reading time of 4 minutes; scatter plots reveal no clean law linking length to applause.

item.title: Golden Gate draws 14.6 million visits — 94× the median national park
item.description: Golden Gate National Recreation Area recorded 14.6 million visits in the dataset's peak year — 94 times the system median of 155,219 across 21,560 park-year records from 1904–2016.

item.title: Squid Game Season 2 Logs 730 Million Netflix Hours — 292× the Catalog Median
item.description: Squid Game Season 2 logged 730 million hours viewed on Netflix — 292 times the 2.5 million-hour catalog median across 27,803 titles.

item.title: Netflix carried more movies than TV shows through 2021—but the longest titles were interactive films
item.description: Black Mirror: Bandersnatch hit 312 minutes; median duration rose from 41 to 98 minutes between 2008 and 2021 as the catalog skewed longer.

item.title: Nuclear test body-wave magnitudes peaked at 7.40 across 2,051 recorded detonations
item.description: Public seismic catalogs reveal a median magnitude of 0.00—mostly missing data—while maximum recorded yields reached 7.40.

item.title: NYC Restaurant Inspections Show 15-Point Median, 156-Point Outlier
item.description: NYC restaurant inspection scores cluster at 15; highest violation count reaches 156 in 100,000-record TidyTuesday extract.

item.title: Pixar's 96% median critic score broke twice—Cars 2 and Lightyear
item.description: Pixar's median Rotten Tomatoes score is 96%, but Cars 2 hit 40% and Lightyear stalled the streak—data from 24 rated theatrical features.

item.title: 69,027 LCSH Records Anchor Project Gutenberg's Catalog Core
item.description: LCSH accounts for 69% of subject headings; PS (American literature) appears 4,684 times — concentration defines the reusable public-domain canon.

item.title: U.S. radio stations cluster at 101 MHz — except News/Talk, which sits 1,039 above median
item.description: 17,186 station records show Country owns format share while News/Talk owns the upper AM band — frequency and culture answer different questions.

item.title: Malaysia averages 4.25 stars — 0.50 above the global ramen median
item.description: 3,180 instant-ramen reviews show a 5.00-star ceiling and country gaps of 0.25–0.50 stars around the 3.75 median.

item.title: 691 albums, median rank 250 — Rolling Stone's 2003 canon structure
item.description: The 2003 Rolling Stone list puts median rank at 250; "Touch" sits at 500, studio albums dominate, and 1955–2019 releases populate the canon.

item.title: Constantine lasted 31 years—Nerva–Antonine emperors averaged 12.5 above median
item.description: Constantine ruled 31 years; the median emperor lasted 6.5—dynasty membership did not close that gap.

item.title: U.S. School Diversity Peaks at 85.3, Median Holds at 2.38
item.description: Butteville Union Elementary scores 85.3 on the Multi index while the national median sits at 2.38 across 27,944 local education agencies.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes Stories Cluster Around 12 Words per Record in Tokenized Corpus
item.description: Tokenized Holmes corpus from TidyTuesday shows median 12.0 words, mean 10.9, with top five titles holding 34% of aggregate count.

item.title: Marcia Wallace Appeared 175 Times — More Than Any Other Simpsons Guest Star
item.description: Marcia Wallace logged 175 guest appearances across 30 Simpsons seasons—2.7× more than the second-place performer in the TidyTuesday dataset.

item.title: Five brands capture 87% of post-game Super Bowl ad views on YouTube
item.description: NFL leads at 403,641 views; median dropped from 111,814 to 33,766 as the 2006–2021 archive filled with ordinary uploads.

item.title: Median Prestige-TV Scores Rose 0.29 Points from 1990 to 2018—Not the Leap Critics Claimed
item.description: Median season ratings climbed from 7.86 to 8.15 across 2,266 records—a raised floor, not a sudden elite leap.

item.title: UK Museums Cluster in Less-Deprived Areas — Wiltshire Leads, Cornwall Trails
item.description: 4,191 UK museums mapped to area deprivation: median 5.00, maximum 10.0, with South West England showing 3-point admin-area gaps.

item.title: Brazil Dominates UN Roll-Call Records — 747 Appearances in 100,000-Vote Sample
item.description: In a 100,000-row UN voting extract, Brazil appears 747 times and 79,663 votes (80%) are affirmative — before ideological coalition modeling begins.

item.title: Social Sciences Drove 63% of U.S. Doctorate Growth, 2008–2017
item.description: Five fields produced 63% of U.S. PhDs; social sciences led at 4,944 degrees while the median field awarded just 85.

item.title: Vermont Led U.S. Public Tuition at $13,486; National Median Rose 56% by 2015
item.description: Median state tuition climbed from $5,876 to $9,141 across 2004–2015; Vermont led at $13,486 while five states held 38% of aggregate value.

item.title: National Turnout Hit 132.6 Million While Median State Recorded 1.17 Million Votes
item.description: National turnout reached 132.6 million in 2014 while the median state recorded 1.17 million votes across 936 elections from 1980–2014.

item.title: Steam Concurrency 2012–2021 — Median Player Count Rose 46 % While a Dozen Titles Captured Half the Audience
item.description: Median concurrent players climbed from 212 to 309 across the decade, but Dota 2's 475,924 average dwarfs the top-twelve median of 64,656.

item.title: Games That Delivered 10+ Hours Per Dollar Own 12% of Steam's Top Shelf
item.description: 26,688 Steam titles show critic scores rising from 70 to 73 between 2004–2018 while million-owner games beat the median by 10 points.

item.title: Income share in mid-tier brackets rose 6.6 points above the median; top brackets trailed by 6.7
item.description: Middle income groups claimed 16% more share; top earners held 6.7 points less than the 10.9% median between 1967 and 2019.

item.title: Page Speed Improved 31% at the Median Between 2016 and 2022
item.description: Median P50 fell from 7.00 to 4.80 across 238 HTTP Archive records, though desktop and mobile showed different speed profiles.

item.title: 100,000 wine ratings reveal a 2-point spread between Austria and Chile
item.description: Austria leads Chile by 2.00 points; the median sits at 88.0 in a dataset where the top dozen titles all score 100.

item.title: Sweden Added 15 UNESCO Sites by 2022 While Denmark Grew 150%
item.description: Sweden led Scandinavia with 15 UNESCO sites by 2022; Denmark's count grew 150% from 2004. Median rose from 5 to 10 sites.

item.title: Dragon-types earn their 100 median Attack — Bug-types don't recover from 60
item.description: Game Freak's type system encodes stat tradeoffs, power creep clusters at the tail, and Cosmoem weighs 999.9 kg at 0.1 meters.

item.title: 48% of U.S. Hospitals Still Exceed CMS's 30-Day Readmission Benchmark
item.description: 48.1% of hospital-condition pairs exceed CMS's expected readmission rate; Hip/Knee leads at 1.00485 ERR—nearly twice the excess of the next track.

item.title: Caesar scored 0.95 on Need for Power — then trusted the men who killed him
item.description: Caesar's LTA profile shows 0.95 Need for Power and 0.31 Distrust — he built an empire on magnanimity and died when three pardoned senators proved the theory wrong.

item.title: The Giants won three World Series in five years at payroll rank 9
item.description: San Francisco's 2010–2014 dynasty won three titles with a draft-built rotation at mid-tier payroll—then couldn't replicate the model.

item.title: 73 wins, four titles, and the franchise that rewrote basketball offense
item.description: Golden State won 73 games in 2015–16, launched 15 more threes per game than the league, and changed how every franchise builds offense.

item.title: Ethiopia scores 85.3 — highest coffee quality, zero Starbucks stores
item.description: Ethiopia's median CQI cup score is 85.3 — the highest of 16 countries with 20+ samples — yet Starbucks operates zero stores in the top three scoring nations.

item.title: H3's Nine-Month Peak Created a Viewership Ceiling the Podcast Never Reached Again
item.description: Frenemies tripled H3 Podcast monthly views in 2020–2021. The show has contracted 70% since, running 220+ minutes per episode for a core audience.

item.title: What Empire Chronicles Leave Out: Who Got Rich
item.description: A historical-economics lens asks who captured wealth when rulers claimed order.

item.title: Pokémon's $91B Earns More Than Marvel, Star Wars, and Harry Potter Combined
item.description: Pokémon at $91B tops 107 franchises tracked. Merchandise drives 61% of all revenue. Disney owns $426B across subsidiaries.

item.title: What a Century of Anime Titles Reveals About the Industry
item.description: MyAnimeList metadata on more than 13,000 titles traces Japanese animation as a output system.
